biggest_catch: Mass Save is Massachusetts-only, and the amounts are per-appliance with strings attached: the $150 washer rebate (2026) requires replacing a functioning top-load washer WITH an agitator and passing verification; the $200 dryer tier requires a heat-pump model on the ENERGY STAR Most Efficient list.
catches: Massachusetts residential customers only, served by a Mass Save electric sponsor (Cape Light Compact, Eversource, National Grid, Unitil).

The $150 clothes washer rebate (2026) requires replacing a functioning top-load washer with an agitator, verification at MassSave.com/GetVerified, purchase between Jan 1 and Dec 31, 2026, and submission by Feb 28, 2027.
Dryer rebate is $50 standard, $200 only for heat-pump dryers on the ENERGY STAR Most Efficient list.
Equipment must be ENERGY STAR certified and new.
Rebate paid by mail or eCheck after review — not instant at checkout.

c3.evidence: No enrollment fee; you buy the appliance and claim the rebate.

c4.evidence: Official pages state the rebate is claimed by online/mail submission with receipt; washer form sets the Feb 28, 2027 submission deadline.

steps: Confirm you're a Massachusetts residential customer of a Mass Save electric sponsor (check your bill: Cape Light Compact, Eversource, National Grid, or Unitil).
Buy an ENERGY STAR certified clothes dryer or washer that meets the tier rules (heat-pump dryer for $200; for the washer, you must be replacing a functioning top-load washer with an agitator).
Keep your receipt showing the product, purchase date, price, and store name.
For the washer: complete verification at MassSave.com/GetVerified before applying.
Submit the rebate form at MassSave.com/Savings (or mail it) with your receipt — no later than Feb 28, 2027 for the 2026 washer rebate.
Receive your rebate by mail or eCheck after review.
timing: Rebate paid by mail or eCheck after your submission is reviewed.
